triples.subject: Fyodor Pavlovitch
triples.quote: If there is one of the sons that is like Fyodor Pavlovitch in character, it is Ivan Fyodorovitch.

triples.subject: Fyodor Pavlovitch
triples.quote: formerly the servant, and possibly the illegitimate son, of Fyodor Pavlovitch, Smerdyakov.

triples.subject: Pavel Smerdyakov
triples.quote: formerly the servant, and possibly the illegitimate son, of Fyodor Pavlovitch, Smerdyakov.

triples.subject: Ivan Fyodorovitch Karamazov
triples.quote: Everything in the world is lawful according to him, and nothing must be forbidden in the future—that is what he always taught me.

triples.subject: Ivan Fyodorovitch Karamazov
triples.quote: which justifies me in speaking rather openly of him now, of course, not as an individual, but as a member of the Karamazov family.

triples.subject: Ippolit Kirillovitch
triples.quote: because the latter had on one or two occasions got the better of him in argument, and Ippolit Kirillovitch, remembering it, tried now to take his revenge.

triples.subject: Dmitri Karamazov
triples.quote: Because he was of the broad Karamazov character—that’s just what I am leading up to—capable of combining the most incongruous contradictions

triples.subject: Dmitri Karamazov
triples.quote: appropriated that three thousand unconditionally, and squandered it in two days with the new object of his affections.

triples.subject: Ippolit Kirillovitch
triples.quote: We’ve seen to-day in this court that there are still good impulses in his young heart

triples.subject: Dmitri Karamazov
triples.quote: He is the prisoner before us. We have his life and his actions, too, before us; the fatal day has come and all has been brought to the surface.
